Commentary.Commentary: End of the league stages and three Asian teams have qualified for the semi-finals along with the host nation. Sri Lanka will be disappointed as they had their moments in the game but failed to capitalize. So, that sets us up for two thrilling knockout encounters. England will first take on Pakistan at the Sophia Gardens in Cardiff on 14th June at 1030 local (0930 GMT). That will be followed by the clash between Bangladesh and India in Birmingham the next day at the same time. Join us for all the action. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Sri Lanka skipper, Angelo Mathews says it was a seesaw kind of a game. Adds Pakistan held their nerve and they are deserving winners. Feels it was a funny wicket to play on, didn't have enough runs on the board but the bowlers were brilliant and he thought they could restrict them. Further adds they unfortunately dropped a few catches which cost them. States he's very proud of the boys for fighting the way they did, despite having only 236 to defend. Rues the dropped chances again. Reckons they got off to a good start but lost wickets in the middle. Ends by saying it is an inexperienced team but proud of the way his team fought so hard.

Pakistan skipper and Man of the Match, Sarfraz Ahmed thanks the Almighty first up. Adds he can't believe they won and how unbelievably well Mohammad Amir played. Mentions he told him (Amir) not to worry about the score and just to play his natural game. States the situation at one point was very tough, but seeing Amir play so confidently helped him relieve some pressure off. Thanks the Almighty once more for the victory in this game. Continues to say that the bowlers bowled really well. Adds that in the first three overs, there was a bit of movement but with the sun coming out, the track got better to bat on. Says that he is very impressed with Fakhar Zaman and that he is a good prospect for Pakistan. Feels that England are a very tough team and they are very good in home conditions. Ends by saying that they will look to play positive cricket against them.

However, Sarfraz Ahmed and Mohammad Amir were resilient and battled it out in the middle. The former survived a few run out chances and he was dropped on two occasions as well. Schoolboy errors from the Lankans they were and that let Sarfraz off the hook. The skipper batted sensibly and he was supported well by Amir who kept on rotating the strike. The unbeaten 75-run stand between them sealed the deal for Pakistan. The Sri Lankan bowlers tried hard but their fielders let them down today. The pressure got the better of them and it led to their downfall.

Pakistan have held their nerves to come out victorious in this knockout encounter. The jubilation on the faces of Sarfraz Ahmed and Mohammad Amir is evident and the Men in Green book their spot for the semi-final. Fakhar Zaman and Azhar Ali took their side to a good start and laid the platform. However, the Islanders fought back emphatically. Credit to the Sri Lankan bowlers for hitting consistent lines and lengths and troubling the shaky batting line-up. They slipped from 74/0 to 137/6 and it looked like Pakistan's unpredictability will come back to haunt them.

FOUR! PAKISTAN ARE THROUGH! Sarfraz Ahmed has seen his side over the line and that's a fantastic victory for Mickey Arthur's men. Short and outside off, Sarfraz ramps it across the third man fence for a boundary. He runs to celebrate with his teammates, then kneels down to thank the Almighty. Superb stuff. PAKISTAN WIN BY 3 WICKETS!
Slow dipping full toss on middle and leg, whipped away behind square on the leg side for two more. Just a boundary away now, Pakistan.
Full toss on the pads. Sarfraz flicks this towards fine leg. Runs the first one hard and as a result, is able to come back for the second. Excellent running.
Short of a length outside off, taps it down in front of point and completes a brisk single.
Wide! Short but it's too short, the umpire signals wide.
Full on middle and leg, flicked away on the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Go 'head, Mohammad Amir! Do it for your team. What a hit. Sees this full delivery and superbly drives it through the covers for a boundary. In 36 balls, the Men in Green need just 11 runs to win.
Straighter one on off, Amir is forward in defense and gets an inside edge on the back pad. The keeper appeals but then stops seeing he's the only one doing it.
Full ball which is driven to long on for a single.
Amir looks to push this to the covers but ends up getting an inside edge to mid-wicket. Runs to the other end as there is a shy at Sarfraz's end. Misses and the run is completed.
Outside off on a length, punched to point off the back foot.
Floats it up on off from around the wicket, Mohammad Amir is forward in defense.
Asela Gunaratne returns to the attack.
Tossed up outside off, eased through extra cover for an easy run. 17 to win off 42.
Bit streaky form Sarfraz but he does amazingly well in the end. Waits for this short ball going across him and steers it to short third man for a quick single.
Darts this one on the pads, punched straight to short mid-wicket.
Flatter and shorter outside off, pushed to the covers for a quick single.
Sliding on middle, Amir goes back and tucks it square on the leg side.
From around the wicket, he bowls it around off, Amir plays it back to him.
Dhananjaya de Silva to bowl.
Driven this to mid on for nothing. 20 runs needed off 48. Pakistan are almost there.
7th ODI fifty for Sarfraz Ahmed!
FOUR! Fifty for Sarfraz Ahmed! He's been given lives, but he's done his part by taking full advantage of it. Opens his body up a bit and drives it through the left of mid off for a boundary.
Worked it off his pads in front of square on the leg side for one.
50-run stand up between Sarfraz Ahmed and Mohammad Amir!
Fuller on the stumps, Sarfraz wants to drive this straight back but gets it off the inside half to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Slips this on the pads, Sarfraz just tickles this fine down the leg side. It races away to the fence and that will be a boundary.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Slower delivery on middle, Ahmed defends it down the track.
Another misfield! Fullish outside off, driven towards extra cover where Dhananjaya de Silva makes a mess of it. Concedes a run.

Four Byes! Schoolboy error from Dickwella. Slower delivery outside off, Amir misses his drive. Dickwella kneels and looks to stop it but the ball hits his knee and goes past him. The ball rolls towards the fence. The short fine leg fielder hares after it, dives but fails to cut off the boundary.
Malinga bowls this one right in the blockhole, Amir keeps it out.
Slower delivery around off, Amir drives it through covers. Two runs taken.

Dropped! Sri Lanka are making major errors! It was a tough chance but it was needed to be taken. Dug in short on off, Ahmed miscues his pull over square leg. The substitute, Seekkuge Prasanna comes running in, puts in a desperate dive, gets his hands to the ball but fails to hold on. Ahmed is a lucky man, he gets another reprieve. A run taken.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled by the umpire. Maximum of five fielders are allowed outside the circle till the end of the innings.
Full and down the leg side, Amir looks to flick it but is hit on the pads.
Lakmal comes around the wicket and bowls another bouncer, Amir sits under it.
Bouncer on middle, Ahmed pulls it through front of square on the leg side. A run taken.
Good length ball in line of the stumps, Ahmed stays back and defends it down the track.
Length delivery around off, Sarfraz shuffles a touch and defends it to the on side.
Good length delivery outside off, Amir runs it down to third man for a single. A loud cheer from the crowd as Sarfraz is back on strike.
Slow once again and full on off, Ahmed is foxed by it as he chips it uppishly towards mid on.
Full length delivery on off, Ahmed drives it crisply to Malinga who manages to get a hand to it to parry it to the mid off fielder. Saves a boundary for his side.
Slow once again and very full on off, Amir squeezes it to covers for a run.
Low full toss down the leg side, tickled to fine leg for a single.

Dropped! Can you believe it? It is a dolly but Perera makes a mess of it. Slower delivery on a fullish length on off, Ahmed chips it uppishly towards Thisara Perera at short mid on. He runs forward, gets hurried into it and ends up spilling it. Malinga is an angry man and he shows his emotions. It is of the key man in the run chase, the Pakistani skipper. How costly will it prove to be?
Wide! Slower delivery that goes wrong. Down the leg side, Ahmed misses his glance.
Dug in short but going down leg, Sarfraz lets it go.
Amir and Sarfraz are having a bit of water. And with that, Lasith Malinga has come on to bowl.
Good length delivery around the pads, Amir tucks it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, Ahmed dabs it neatly to third man. A run taken.
Good length delivery on off, Ahmed hops back and turns it to mid on.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Back of a length ball around off, punched off the back foot to cover-point.

FOUR! Ahmed is a really good cutter of the ball and he gets the desired result! Gets a shortish delivery outside off and slaps it behind point. Gunaratne hares to his right, puts in the dive but fails to stop it.
Suranga Lakmal to have a go again.
Length delivery on leg stump, Amir hangs back and keeps it out.
On a length in line of the stumps, Amir hangs back to defend.

Full length delivery on off, Ahmed leans into it and just strokes it past the bowler. Lakmal moves across to his left from mid on and puts in a desperate dive to parry it towards mid off. Keeps it down to a run.
Short of a length ball on off, defended off the back foot.

Well played! Back of a length delivery outside off, Amir punches it through point. The fielder hares after it to cut it off. Three runs taken. Pakistan need 50 more runs. If they bat out 50 overs, they will win this one.
Short delivery on off, Amir sits under the bumper. He has been peppered with a lot of short stuff but the Sri Lankan bowlers have been a bit off target.
Nuwan Pradeep will bowl out.
Length delivery on middle, Sarfraz stays back and defends it to the leg side.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Wide! Bouncer outside off, Ahmed ducks under it. Wide signaled for height.

Five runs! Sloppy from Sri Lanka! Can't afford this in such a close encounter. Amir taps  it to point and sets off. Gunathilaka dives to his right and makes a half-stop to parry it to his right. The short third man fielder runs in and has an unnecessary shy at the bowler's end. It misses and there is no one to back up. Concedes four extra runs.
Short delivery on middle, Ahmed rises on his toes and pulls it through backward square leg for a single.
Full length delivery outside off, Sarfraz creams it through covers. He has pushed in the gap and by the time the fielder comes across and throws the ball, two runs are taken.
Fullish delivery outside off, Ahmed puts his head down and defends it calmly.
Thisara Perera called back to bowl.
Slow through the air on the pads, Amir flicks it to mid on. Pakistan need 62 runs from 90 balls with three wickets in hand. We are headed for a close finish.
On a length this time, Sarfraz hangs back and punches it to wide long on for a run.
A bit short and it allows Amir enough time to rock back and punch it to deep point. A single taken.
Fullish around off, Mohammad eases it to extra cover.
Close shave! Quicker delivery outside off, Amir goes for the cut but gets an under edge that lands just short of the slip fielder.
Fullish on middle, Amir clips it off the inner half to mid on.
On a length outside off, driven through cover-point for a single.
Leg gully in place now.
Good length delivery slanting across from Amir. He defends it with an angled bat to point.
On a length outside off, Amir punches it past the diving cover fielder. The batsmen turn back for the second as the throw is at the bowler's end. Tight run but Ahmed makes it safely.
Full length delivery outside off, Mohammad strokes it to extra cover.
Fullish and tailing in, flicked through square leg for a run.
Wide down the leg side, No trouble at all for the batsman. Wide signalled by the umpire.

LBW appeal denied! Back of a length delivery around off, jags back in. Ahmed hops back and looks to work it through square leg. Misses to get pinged on the pads. A confident appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Mathews thinks about the review but decides not to take it. The Hawk Eye shows that it would have gone over the leg stump.
Nuwan Pradeep returns.
Full toss this time, Amir mistimes it to mid on. Failed to capitalize on that. A tidy over from Asela, only a run from it.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Slower outside off, Ahmed eases it to long on for a single.
Bowled at a slower pace on off, Ahmed strokes it back to Gunaratne who stops it in his followthrough.
Fullish delivery, pushed to mid on off the front foot.
Slower delivery on middle, Ahmed stays back and punches it to covers.
Good length delivery on off, Amir punches it back to Perera.
Stays back to the length delivery and defends it solidly down the track.
Fullish delivery outside off, Amir strides forward confidently and defends it to covers.
Dug in short, Sarfraz pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Similar length delivery outside off, Ahmed slaps it hard but finds the man at short extra cover.
Short of a length outside off, Ahmed cuts it behind point for a run. Calls for the second as the throw comes to the keeper but he makes it in time.
A chirpy appeal for an LBW turned down! Coming in with the arm, Amir looks to defend it but misses to get rapped on the pads. A confident shout but it is turned down. That was heading down leg.
Floated on off, Amir pushes at it but gets it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Flatter delivery on off, Sarfraz punches it down to long on for a run.
Fullish on middle, Ahmed pushes it down the track.
Spinning into the pads, worked to the leg side.
A touch short outside off, cut through point for a run.
Danushka Gunathilaka to roll his arm over now.
Stays back to this one and defends it out.
Mohammad Amir walks out to bat.

OUT! Completely against the run of play, Fahim Ashraf has been dismissed. Quite unfortunate really. Thisara Perera bowls a fuller length delivery on off, Sarfraz drives it straight back. The bowler sticks his right hand out and gets his fingertips on it. It deflects off 'em and goes on to knock the bails over. Sri Lanka appeal as Ashraf was backing up a bit. It's referred upstairs and replays show that Fahim fails to plant his bat back in time, is run out by the narrowest of margins. He's frustrated but Sri Lanka are ecstatic. Pakistan require 75 to win in 121 deliveries.
There is an appeal for a run out against Fahim Ashraf. The umpire has referred it upstairs.
Pushes it to the covers and rotates strike.
Back of a length around off, Fahim stands tall and pulls it along the ground through the vacant spaces in the mid-wicket area. Will pick up a couple of runs for doing so.
On a good length again, around off, Ahmed gets a leading edge through cover-point and takes a single.
Length delivery to get things going, it's punched back down the track for no run.
Thisara Perera comes into the attack now.
Darted full on middle, dug out back down the track to end the over.
Positions himself well behind the line and meets it with the full face of the bat.

RUN OUT CHANCE GOES BEGGING! Risky, risky, risky run from Sarfraz Ahmed. He works it to the right of the short mid-wicket fielder and sets off. Dhananjaya de Silva is the man there, he runs to his right and fires it at the bowler's end. Misses but had he hit, Ahmed was gone.

Floats it up on leg, Ahmed looks to sweep but gets an inside edge onto his pads fine down the leg side. Wants the single but is correctly sent back in time by his partner as Dickwella was rushing to the ball.
Shorter in length on the stumps, worked away to mid-wicket again.
Starts off from around the wicket and angles it across Sarfraz, the Pakistan skipper leans ahead and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Asela Gunaratne comes back for a bowl.

Drinks break! Sri Lanka have come back tremendously well into the game. Picked up wickets in quick succession and left Pakistan in real trouble. Everything rests on this current pair of Sarfraz and Ashraf. A wicket now and Pakistan could be staring down the barrel. 80 runs required to win off 132 deliveries. What's going to happen?

FOUR LEG BYES! Short delivery down leg, Ashraf looks to get out of it at the last second but the ball goes off his right forearm and lobs over the keeper's head. Races away behind to the fence and that will be a boundary.
Some chin music for the batsman, he lets that bouncer through to the wicketkeeper.
Full ball attacking the stumps, flicked to the right of mid on. Malinga is slow in getting to the ball which allows the batsmen to cross over.
Short of a good length, outside off, Ahmed punches this behind point. Third man cuts it off and in the meantime, the batsmen take two.
Outside off and Ashraf plays this behind point for a run.
FOUR! Pulls and gets another boundary. Short on leg, Ashraf pulls but gets a top edge this time. Gets it fine enough and picks up a one bounce boundary.
Short ball very close to off, cramping Fahim for room but he still manages to run it down to third man for one.

SIX! Well played, young Fahim! Top shot to play under such pressure. It's short and angling in, Ashraf swivels and pulls it over fine leg for a biggie. There was a fielder placed there for this very reason but it doesn't matter, he can only watch it sail over him.
Bouncer on off, Fahim looks to pull but misses as the bounce gets too big on him.
Slow, dipping yorker on the stumps, worked away once more to mid-wicket.
Malinga from around the wicket angles it in on middle and off, Ashraf with a closed face works it to mid-wicket.
Short delivery on middle and off, pulled away along the ground towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery in the corridor outside off, Ashraf has nothing to do with it.
Bowls it full and makes it come back in, Ashraf drives it to mid on.
The debutant, Fahim Ashraf is the next man in. He walks out into the heat of the battle. Pressure situation, does he have it in him to stand tall?

OUT! The change in angle has done the trick! He comes back from over the wicket, makes it go away from Imad Wasim on a shorter length and uses the angle to perfection. The left-hander is drawn into playing at it and nicks it. Dickwella collects it in his gloves and another one bites the dust for Pakistan. The game is turning on its head, 100 off 146 needed to win here.
FOUR! Exquisite timing! Around the wicket, it's full and there to be hit, Wasim accepts it and drives it crisply through the cover area for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for one.
Fullish in length outside off, Ahmed looks to drive but off the inner half plays it back down the track.
Nuwan Pradeep is back.
Low full toss well outside off, Wasim is forward as he defends it away in front of covers.
Wide! Switches the angles and comes from around the wicket to the left-hander, it's fired down the leg side. Wide called.
Imad Wasim walks out to the middle next.

OUT! HE'S GONE! Lasith Malinga has dismissed the veteran Shoaib Malik. This is a big wicket, his experience would have really counted in this chase. Rather tame dismissal too if you look at it. It's short and angling down, Malik looks to pull but ends up gloving it behind. Dickwella moves to his left and takes a simple catch. 106 off 151 needed to win now. Dare I say, Sri Lanka are in the driver's seat here.
Fuller in length on off, driven through the covers for one.

Oh! That's close. Malik walks across and Malinga arrows a yorker on middle and leg, it's however flicked down to fine leg for a run. Bit dangerous to play that kind of shot, especially against a bowler like Malinga.
Outside the line of off stump, steered down to third man for a single.
Venomous yorker from Malinga, on middle, somehow Sarfraz Ahmed jams this one out. Superb delivery, brilliantly bowled and equally well played.
Malik drives this length ball on the up. Opens his body up a bit but fails to find the gap. Places it straight to cover-point.
Decent carry for Lakmal. Hurls it outside off and it's left alone by Shoaib Malik.
Fuller in length and straighter in line, Ahmed flicks this away beautifully through mid-wicket. Big boundary out there, he gets it in the gap and hence picks up three runs for it.
Waits for this one to come to him, plays it very late to third man and picks up one.
Closer to the off pole, Malik cuts it away to point once more.
Good length delivery outside off, Malik punches it square to point.

Takes some pace off this and almost get him. Sarfraz is a bit early into the flick shot and chips it in front of the diving short mid-wicket fielder. Very close. Maiden over, which interestingly is the second of the run chase. Both have come from Malinga only.
Half-volley on off, drives this with the full face of the bat to the mid off fielder.
One more right in the blockhole, Malinga spears this on off, Ahmed drills it out to covers. No run taken.
Fires it full yet again, on off, driven straight back down the track. No run taken.
Full and tailing back in, Sarfraz looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pads to square leg.
Accurate yorker from Malinga, on middle, Sarfraz had to be spot on in jamming this one out. Fortunately for him and his side, he was. Nicely done.
Stays right behind the line of this one and keeps it out.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Fuller in length pitched outside off, driven through to sweeper cover for a single.

CHANCE OF A RUN OUT! The skipper would have been gone had that hit, unnecessary risk to take at this point in time. He pushes it in front of short mid on and sets off. The fielder there gets to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end. Forces Sarfraz to dive to get in. Misses though so no harm done in the end.
On the shorter side of things, played to third man again for another single.
Short of a length outside off, run down to third man for a single.
Risky! Very full delivery, shaping in from around off, Malik shuffles across and jams it out to mid on.
Fullish on off, pushed to mid on off the inner half.

Confusion but Ahmed survives! The skipper taps this with soft hands to covers and initially calls for a run. Malik responds and keeps on running. Gunathilaka comes across to his left as the wicket-keeper batsman stutters a bit but has to go through eventually. Danushka turns and aims at the bowler's end but misses. Had that hit, Pakistan would have lost another wicket.
FOUR! Sweet! Length ball outside off, Ahmed drives it with an open face through point. Good timing on that and he gets the desired result!
Wide! Slips this one down the leg side, Ahmed misses his glance.
That was nearly a toe-crushing yorker. Gets it right in the blockhole as Malik's bat turns in his hands but he manages to keep it out to square leg. A run taken.
Starts off with a short delivery on leg stump, Ahmed pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Lasith Malinga comes back on to bowl.
Good length outside off, dabbed neatly to third man for a single.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Ahmed pushes it towards covers where Gunathilaka goes to his right to stop it.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Shortish outside off, Ahmed goes for the cut but is beaten.
The skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed comes out to bat.

OUT! Lakmal gets the big fish! Ali was important in this chase but he is out of here now. The bowling change has done the trick. Good length delivery outside off, bounces a touch extra. Ali hangs back but is undone by the zippiness. He looks to keep it out but gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies towards Kusal Mendis at wide first slip. He goes towards his right initially but does well to adjust. Takes it to his left side with a reverse cup. The match is finely poised at the moment. Pakistan need 127 runs from 184 balls.
On a length on off, Ali pushes it to mid off.
Suranga Lakmal is back into the attack.
Shortish delivery, Malik rises up on his toes and keeps it out.
Wide! Bouncer but it's too short to trouble the batsman. Wide signaled for height.
Similar length delivery outside off, pulled with ease to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short of a length outside off, Malik slashes hard at it to get it towards third man. A run taken.
Fullish delivery shaping in from outside off, Shoaib puts in a confident stride forward to defend it solidly.
Good length delivery around off, Malik hangs deep in the crease and pushes it to covers.
Fullish delivery outside off, Ali strokes it through covers for a run.
On a length outside off, played with an open face to point.
Fuller length ball well outside off, Azhar places it to to deep point for a single.
Full on off, Malik jams it out towards mid on and takes the slowest of the Sri Lankan fielders, Malinga on. Single easily taken.
Similar length delivery on off, Ali hops back and works it to the leg side for a run.
FOUR! Well played! Back of a length delivery outside off, Ali ramps it over the keeper's head to find the fence.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
FOUR! Gets off the mark in style! Fuller length ball outside off, Malik drills it through cover-point for a boundary.
Shoaib Malik comes out to bat.

OUT! Soft dismissal! Pakistan are losing the plot all of a sudden. Back of a length delivery on middle, Hafeez camps back and looks to turn it through square leg. However, he is early into his shot and ends up getting it from the splice of the bat towards mid on. Nuwan Pradeep comes in towards the ball and also the short mid-wicket fielder. The former calls for it and takes it safely. The pressure is building and the Lankans will know that picking up regular wickets is the way to go.
Short of a length on off, Hafeez stays back and plays it to point.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Good length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Short delivery, sits up nicely for Ali. He pulls it to fine leg for an easy single.
Dug in short, pulled to the leg side for a run and Ali will retain the strike. End of a successful over for the Lankans.
Back of a length delivery, angling in. Hafeez backs away and steers it to third man for a run.
Mohammad Hafeez strides out to bat.

OUT! Pradeep strikes! Azam picks the fielder out to perfection. On a good length and angling in towards the pads, Azam whips it but doesn't bother to keep it down. It flies towards Dhananjaya de Silva who takes a good reflex catch at mid-wicket. Pakistan's reliable man fails to make a mark. Will this wicket lead to a collapse? Sri Lanka will hope so.
Wide! Dug in short but down the leg side, wide called for height.
Fullish delivery on off, pushed firmly off the front foot to mid off.
Good length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot to cover-point.
Wide first slip in place now.
Dug in short on off, Ali swivels across and pulls it through backward square leg for a single.
Drinks break. Pakistan are in a commanding position. They require 147 runs from 210 balls with 9 wickets in hand. Sri Lanka need quick wickets to claw back into the contest.
Fullish on off, Azam pushes it to mid off.
Azam looks to run it down to third man but gets it towards the right of first slip. Wants the run but is sent back.
Ali takes a couple of steps down the track and glides it to third man for a single.
Short of a length on middle, Azam is a bit hurried as he mistimes his pull round the corner. A run taken.

Strong appeal for a caught behind denied! Good length delivery well outside off, Azam looks to slap it square of the wicket on the off side but misses. Dickwella collects it and appeals loudly and the bowler joins him. However, nothing from the umpire. Replays show that there was daylight between bat and ball.
Back of a length delivery, pulled to fine leg for a single.
Shortish and room on offer, Azam cuts it uppishly behind point. This time Lakmal moves to his right to cut it off. Two runs taken.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.

Short of a length outside off, Azam looks to force it square of the wicket but gets an outside edge towards third man. Lakmal comes across to his left and cuts it off. Returns an accurate throw to the keeper as the batsmen complete the run. Dickwella underarms it to the non-striker's end to catch Ali off guard. Misses and the ball rolls past Pradeep who was busy walking back to his bowling mark. Concedes two overthrows.
Fullish and tailing into Babar. He clips it to mid-wicket.
Dug in short on off, Ali sits under the bumper.
In the channel outside off, holding its line. Ali plants his front foot across and lets it go.
This one jags back into Azam. He works it to the mid-wicket fielder.
Bouncer outside off, Azam ducks under it.
Good length delivery outside off, Babar pushes it off the back foot to covers.
Length delivery, angling in. Azam turns it to the leg side.
Wide! Slips this one down the leg side, Babar looks to nudge it but misses.
Similar length ball on off, Azhar shuffles a touch and wrists it to mid on for a single.
Length delivery around off, Ali stays back and defends it to the off side.
Thisara Perera comes back into the attack.
FOUR! Shot! He played that with a lot of authority. Short and room on offer, Azam slaps it through point for a rocketing boundary. Gets off the mark in style.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Azam cuts it towards point where the fielder makes a leaping half-stop.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short of a length on off, Azam goes back to defend but gets a bottom edge that just rolls past the off stump.
Babar Azam comes out to bat.

OUT! Zaman holes out! Dug in short on leg stump, Fakhar goes for the big pull shot but ends up top edging it towards fine leg. Asela Gunaratne stays composed and bends low to take a fine reverse cup catch. Pradeep provides the crucial breakthrough for his side. A breezy knock from the youngster comes to an end. It could be argued that he threw it away but that is the way he bats. Pakistan need 163 to win off 232 balls.
Full length ball on middle, Zaman defends it back down the track.
Nuwan Pradeep is back on.
Maiden ODI fifty for Fakhar Zaman!

Length delivery on off, Zaman dabs it towards point for a single. A well-deserved half century for him. He has given the much-needed intent that was required for the Pakistani side at the top of the order. Makes his mark in his second ODI. He needs to carry on.
FOUR! Deft! This young man is talented. A touch short outside off, Fakhar waits for it and dabs it through the vacant third man region for a boundary.
This one cuts back into Ali. He stays leg side of the ball and taps it to covers for a single.
On a length on off, Zaman puches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fullish on midle, Azhar clips it towards short mid-wicket. Mathews dives full length to his right but is unable to stop it. A run taken.
Slow delivery outside off, Zaman eases it to covers for a single.
Asela Gunaratne is brought into the attack. A good move, taking some pace off in the attack will probably do Sri Lanka some good.
Powerplay 2 signalled. 4 fielders can now be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Angles it into Fakhar Zaman again, he swivels and pulls it along the ground behind square on the leg side for a simple run.
Wide! Short and angling way down, easy leave for the batsman.
Back of a length outside off, backs away a little and crunches it to backward point.
Follows him again as he makes room once more, Zaman works it away through backward square leg for a double.
Fakhar looks to make room but Lakmal bangs in a short one on leg, the batsman can only duck and evade.
FOUR! Errs in line and angles it down the leg side, Fakhar just tickles it fine and picks up a boundary. Fine leg was too square so couldn't stop it.
Comes from around the wicket and angles it in on middle and leg, catches the left-hander on the thigh pad who looks to block.
Change of ends for Suranga Lakmal.
Full delivery which is driven towards mid off for a brisk single.

SIX! That's gone all the way despite going off the top edge. Wow! Just shows how short that boundary is. Length ball on the stumps, Zaman swings hard across the line. Goes off the top edge and flies away over the stands and possibly into the river outside.
Beats him for pace, shapes back in sharply and raps him high on the thigh pad. The appeal is turned down as a result and a leg bye is taken.
Length ball going away around off, punched to the right of mid on who makes a tumbling stop. Single taken.
Short ball from Pradeep, it's ducked and evaded.

FOUR! Oh, boy... That's poor from Asela. Pradeep with a great delivery as he lands it around off, makes it go away ever so slightly and draws the edge. It goes behind but falls short of Gunaratne positioned at wide first slip. He, however, cannot stop it as he lets it through him. It goes all the way to the rope for a boundary.
Zaman just helps this down to third man and earns himself a single. 13 runs off the over, an excellent one for Pakistan.
Slightly fullish in length, blocked.
Wide! Fires it down the leg side, nothing from the batsman. Wide called by the umpire.
FOUR! Fakhar has mauled that! The left-hander has got his dancing shoes on, he skips out and hammers it straight back down the ground for a boundary.
Manages to work it through mid-wicket this time and gets off strike.
Bit short, Ali closes the face a bit too early to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge which bobbles towards the covers.
With the ball being lost, we are going to have a replacement. Umpire Ian Gould brings out a box and a different one is taken.

SIX! Oh my word, what a hit! Azhar Ali with a monstrous strike to send that outta here. Fuller length delivery and he charges down the track, makes perfect connection and with the full swing of his bat, clears the stadium down the ground. Pretty sure the ball has been lost too.
Thisara Perera to have a bowl now.
The batsman has played it fine down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.

That's a real peach! Pradeep lands this on a length around off, Azhar looks to play at it but it jags back in sharply and goes off the thigh pad to the keeper. The keeper goes up in an appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Short of a length outside off, Zaman walks a couple of steps down the track, looks to run it down to third man but gets an outside edge to the same region. A run taken.
Wide! Way outside off this time, Fakhar once again tries to go after it but it's too far out.
Gets this one to angle across the southpaw, Zaman has a go at it but fails to make connection.
Shortish outside off, Ali is well in control of this shot. Off the outer half he plays this down to third man for a single.
Length delivery around off, the right-hander plays it back to the bowler.
Nuwan Pradeep is called into the attack.
Picks it off his pads and flicks it away on the on side for a single.
On the fuller side of things and on the stumps, driven back down the track where Lakmal gets low and stops it in his followthrough.
FOUR! Length ball angling back in, Azhar Ali camps back and heaves it over mid-wicket. Nobody out there in the deep so the ball will race away to the fence.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Angling down a bit, Zaman looks to glance it fine down the leg side but the ball goes off his thigh pad on the leg side. Leg bye taken.
Straighter in line, on middle and leg, flicked to mid on.
Full ball coming back in, driven towards mid on.

Zaman drops it in front of extra cover and hares across. Chandimal runs in to the ball and under arms it at the striker's end, gets a direct hit but to no effect. Azhar has planted his bat in by then.
Back of a length delivery, punched straight to the cover-point fielder.
Angling in from around the wicket, on off, Fakhar punches it back in Malinga's direction.
Short and wide outside off, easy enough to cut it away to third man for a single.
Angling back in on middle and leg, worked in front of mid-wicket from inside his crease. Wants the run, but then is sent back by his partner.
FOUR! Short and angling down, Zaman pulls it down to fine leg and ends the over with a boundary.
Finally he's off the mark. Drives it back down the ground and scurries to the other end.

Full on off, driven straight back to Lakmal. The pacer collects the ball and fires it back to the keeper, in the process almost taking Azhar Ali's head off. Controlled aggression it seems, he has a cheeky smile on his face as he walks back.
Just sits up to Ali, he stands back and defends it well.
Lands it on a length on off, blocked with a straight bat.
Short of a good length outside off, Azhar has some room to work with so he attempts to cut it away. The bounce gets a little big on him so he isn't able to connect.

Great comeback from Malinga, ends the over with a superb delivery. Angles it in around off from wide of the crease, Fakhar hangs his bat out to it and almost nicks it as the ball goes past the edge behind to the keeper. A good over for Pakistan nonetheless, 12 runs off it.
FOUR! Oh, what a shot! Gets a juicy half-volley outside off, Zaman leans into it beautifully and crisply drives it through the gap in the covers to send it across the boundary line.
From around the wicket, it's a length delivery outside off, left alone by the southpaw.

FOUR! Super shot. He goes in the same area and gets the same result. This time Malinga rolls his fingers over the ball but it doesn't matter to Zaman, he drives this firmly between cover and point for consecutive boundaries.
FOUR! That's a good shot. Another dipping full toss outside off, Zaman leans into it and drives it between cover and point. Pierces the gap perfectly and gets his first boundary.
Low dipping full toss on the stumps, Zaman deals with it well as he plays it to mid off.
Good length ball very close to off, plays this on the up as he drives it to the cover fielder.
Plays it to mid-wicket again. Another dot ball.
Lands it on a length around off, Ali walks across the line and works it to mid-wicket.
Bit ahead of a length around off, driven hard but straight to the cover fielder.

All happening out there! Fakhar Zaman drops this with soft hands in front of point and calls for the run. Azhar responds as Gunathilaka charges in towards the ball. Dives forward to collect it but cannot do so cleanly. Azhar running to get to the other end collides with the fielder and somehow adjusts to dive in. He's not too happy about that.
Around off, defended with the full face of the bat.
Wide! Spills it down the leg side, easy call for the umpire to signal it a wide.
Suranga Lakmal to bowl from the other end with the second new ball. A couple of slips placed for him too.
Outside off, left alone to end the over. Maiden over to get things going.

Dropped! Wrong person to drop, Danushka. This could have been the dream start Sri Lanka wanted. Short and wide, Azhar Ali cuts it aerially to point. Gunathilaka gets low on his knees to his left, gets his hands to it but ends up spilling it.
Just back of a length, punched away a bit square on the off side.
Azhar offers a solid punch to covers. It was coming on a length outside off, the batsman meets it with the full face of the bat.
Good shape, good line and good length. Malinga gets some decent carry on this as Azhar Ali lets it go after covering his stumps.
Good length delivery in the off stump channel, Azhar Ali leaves it alone. Expected start to the innings.

We're back for the second half of this match. A pressure chase, for the final semi-final spot. Fakhar Zaman and Azhar Ali stride out to the middle with the Lankans spreading out across the field. Lasith Malinga is going to take the first new ball and he will have two slips in place. Here we go...
